why: cmux #57249: every person's new terminal or browser from a focused Cloud chat (pane toolbar, keys, palette, menu bar, Cmd-D splits, Split Browser, New Tab picks) opens on the chat's Cloud machine. The decision rules are pure in CmuxNextCloud (CloudChatFocus.resolve and CloudChatFocus.pick, tested there); the App keeps only adapters: CloudFrontedChats.cloudChat/openOnCloud reading AppServices (machines, fronts, panes, strip selection) into CloudChatFocus.Shown, one call in each existing handler (TabLifecycle, PaneHandlers, BrowserHandlers, NewTabPage), the per-page origin map and the typing hand-off to the header's openTool route from #55490.
